answers.question: Are my conversations used for model training by default?
answers.answer: Yes, by default your conversations are used for model training. However, if you turn off Keep Activity or use temporary chats, your future chats will not be used to improve AI models (unless you submit feedback). You can control this through the Keep Activity setting.

citations.title: Gemini Apps Privacy Hub - Gemini Apps Help

answers.question: How long are my conversations kept?
answers.answer: If Keep Activity is on, your conversations are auto-deleted after 18 months by default (you can change this to 3 or 36 months, or choose not to auto-delete). If Keep Activity is off or you use temporary chats, conversations are kept for 72 hours. If you submit feedback, those conversations are retained for up to 3 years disconnected from your account.

citations.title: Gemini Apps Privacy Hub - Gemini Apps Help

answers.question: How can I stop my conversations being used for training?
answers.answer: To stop your conversations from being used for training, turn off the Keep Activity setting. When Keep Activity is off, your future chats won't be used to train AI models, unless you send feedback, though they're still saved for 72 hours to allow Google to respond and process feedback.

citations.title: Gemini Apps Privacy Hub - Gemini Apps Help

answers.question: How can I delete my conversations?
answers.answer: You can delete conversations by going to gemini.google.com, clicking Settings & help → Activity, and choosing what to delete: all activity, last hour/day, a custom time range, a specific day, or individual conversations. You can also visit myactivity.google.com/product/gemini to manage your activity.
